# Codex Trajectory v1.1.0

Version 1.1.0 fixes native panel initialization on hosts that expose both the standard MCP Apps interface and legacy compatibility aliases. It also ships the task timing and subagent usage improvements merged since 1.0.0.

- Always complete the standard `ui/initialize` / `ui/notifications/initialized` handshake, even when `window.openai.callTool` is available. Prefer the negotiated native transport while preserving bounded fallback for legacy hosts and safe teardown of delayed initialization replies.
- Add regression coverage for both interfaces being present, with and without preloaded results, delayed native replies, viewer closure, and rejected or unsupported legacy probes.
- Show current-task timing distribution, separating local/tool execution, estimated model/token time, and unattributed time. Retain uncertainty and incomplete-coverage indicators.
- Include recursively related subagents in task Token and estimated-cost totals, while turn details continue to show the selected agent.
- Remove startup history prewarming and stream bounded compressed metadata discovery. Load timing support with the dispatcher to avoid mixed runtime modules after in-place updates.
- Keep the native task-panel entry and `show_codex_trajectory`; remove the global left-toolbar registration. Published trajectory schemas v1 and v2 remain unchanged.

## Upgrade

```sh
codex plugin marketplace upgrade icesixgod
codex plugin add codex-trajectory@icesixgod
```

After installing, **fully quit and reopen Codex** before reopening an existing task's panel. On macOS use **Cmd+Q**. Closing only the panel can retain the old UI resource or an older MCP process. If an entry briefly reports `Transport closed` while reconnecting, wait for the plugin connection and retry the panel.

See the [changelog](https://github.com/icesixgod/codex-trajectory/blob/v1.1.0/CHANGELOG.md#110---2026-10-25) and [native viewer guide](https://github.com/icesixgod/codex-trajectory/blob/v1.1.0/docs/native-viewer.md) for details.

## 简体中文

1.1.0 修复了宿主同时提供标准 MCP Apps 接口与旧版兼容接口时，原生侧栏初始化超时的问题，同时发布 1.0.0 之后合入的任务耗时与子代理用量改进。

- 即使存在 `window.openai.callTool`，也完整执行标准初始化握手；优先使用协商后的标准通道，并保留旧宿主回退、延迟响应处理和关闭后的清理。
- 补充两种接口共存、初始结果预加载、迟到握手、关闭查看器及旧接口回退等回归测试。
- 展示当前任务的本地/工具、模型/Token 与未归属耗时，并保留不确定性和覆盖率说明。
- 在任务 Token 与估算费用中汇总递归关联的子代理；轮次详情仍展示选定代理。
- 移除启动时的历史预热，流式读取压缩元数据；统计模块随分发器加载，避免原位升级后混用新旧运行模块。
- 保留任务右侧面板入口与 `show_codex_trajectory`，移除左侧全局入口；已发布的 v1/v2 数据结构保持不变。

按上方命令更新后，请**完全退出并重新打开 Codex**，macOS 使用 **⌘Q**，然后再打开原聊天侧栏。仅重开面板可能继续使用旧页面或旧 MCP 进程。连接重建期间若短暂出现 `Transport closed`，等待插件就绪后重试即可。
